canonical_review_vocabulary.source_issuer_identity: a proven server-origin issuer identity; NOT a registry pointer
canonical_review_vocabulary.issuer_registry_ref: opaque origin/provenance registry pointer; NOT issuer identity
canonical_review_vocabulary.verification_key_id: key ID in issuer-scoped key registry; NOT issuer ref
canonical_review_vocabulary.integrity_proof: typed kind/algorithm_id/encoding/value plus verified coverage; NOT an automatic rename of signature, integrity_signature or R005 mac
canonical_review_vocabulary.business_core_digest: hashed identity of committed canonical business core; NOT proof signature/MAC
canonical_review_vocabulary.source_auth_version: event origin Auth-version snapshot; not consumer-time read
canonical_review_vocabulary.observed_auth_version: consumer-time server Auth read; not signed source snapshot
canonical_review_vocabulary.source_session_version: event origin SessionVersion; not active-session requirement for revoked events
canonical_review_vocabulary.observed_session_version: consumer-time SessionVersion monotonic fence; not always source equality
canonical_review_vocabulary.source_actor_pseudonym: nonreversible event actor reference, not raw member ID
canonical_review_vocabulary.source_session_pseudonym: nonreversible event session reference, not Session ID
canonical_review_vocabulary.server_actor_reference: trusted internal actor resolved by server, not hash alias
canonical_review_vocabulary.server_member_reference: trusted internal member resolved by server, not hash alias
canonical_review_vocabulary.proof_issued_at: envelope proof creation clock; NOT business occurred_at
canonical_review_vocabulary.proof_nonce: issuer-scoped replay nonce requiring durable fence

version_strategy.layer1: Keep existing 11 approved-direction CORE names + conditional idempotency; do not add unknown G06 thirteenth field
version_strategy.layer2: Independent review-only security_envelope_schema_version candidate; never silently equate with business schema_version
version_strategy.compatibility: Create future explicit, audited (core_version,envelope_version,issuer_key_epoch,proof_kind) allowlist after AI0 approval; unknown or missing or unsupported version -> reject, no automatic alias
version_strategy.canonicalization: No final wire format, signing bytes, signature algorithm or HMAC key custody approved; R005 HMAC mac remains OFFLINE only; no parser or signer in this W2
version_strategy.time: occurred_at business time != proof_issued_at; source version != observed current version
version_strategy.change_policy: New name requires its own semantics, authority, security classification and explicit review/major version; no cross-brand fallback, no user-supplied verified flag

field_reconciliation.source: AI1 W1 names issuer as untyped server-origin identity proposal; AI3 W1 uses issuer_ref as opaque provenance lookup/reference. Neither has a final value type or binding schema.
field_reconciliation.authority: AI-0 G06 chooses issuer trust model; trusted server origin/AI-1 current Auth authority, never public client
field_reconciliation.condition: Only after an approved issuer registry attests identity→opaque ref within same app/env/epoch
field_reconciliation.version: Registry identity & issuer epoch not automatically equal an opaque identifier; no carry-through
field_reconciliation.signature_coverage: Issuer identity/ref must each be explicitly bound if used; neither proves signature on its own

field_reconciliation.source: Both W1 candidate words are untyped. AI1 R005 actual offline outer field is mac (HMAC-SHA256 hex), which is neither the W1 signature wire field nor a production issuer.
field_reconciliation.authority: AI-0 approved signer/key custody and AI-1/AI-4 trusted verifier after Gate
field_reconciliation.proposed: integrity_proof {kind, algorithm_id, encoding, value} (typed review candidate, NOT signed bytes)
field_reconciliation.condition: Never rename without proof type, algorithm, canonical signed bytes, key, signature/MAC differentiation and verification result
field_reconciliation.version: Proof algorithm/canonicalization/key epoch are independently versioned; MAC cannot be relabeled asymmetric signature
field_reconciliation.signature_coverage: Full authenticated scope, business_core digest, envelope version, issuer identity, time, nonce and event binding must be specified and verified by final G06

field_reconciliation.source: AI1 W1/R005 session_version is an event/signed issuer-bound snapshot; AI3 W1 current_session_version describes a later authoritative read/fence and was not defined as the same snapshot.
field_reconciliation.authority: AI-1 sole Session writer and authoritative server-side reread, not incoming user-supplied value
field_reconciliation.condition: Correlate with a monotonicity/fence check and snapshot provenance; equality is event-class-specific, never an unconditional renaming
field_reconciliation.version: Source signed at origin; observed is current time-of-consumption. Revocation may advance version; do not require revoked session ACTIVE
field_reconciliation.signature_coverage: Source snapshot if signed; observed version is not automatically covered by old source signature and must be authenticated separately

field_reconciliation.source: AI1 event-level auth_version is an emitted snapshot, AI3 current_auth_version is consumer-time current Auth read and may advance on revoke/delete.
field_reconciliation.authority: AI-1 sole Auth/member writer; independently re-read trusted authority
field_reconciliation.condition: Require source commit+monotonic fence and checked transition; never equality check just because same name suffix
field_reconciliation.version: May increase as revocation completes; compare according to event transition status instead of rejecting authoritative revoked event
field_reconciliation.signature_coverage: Original source version may be signed; observed live version needs its own authenticated DB evidence

field_reconciliation.source: AI1 W1 and AI3 W1 both propose kid; AI1 R005 actually uses issuer_kid. Bare name equality is not shared key registry or issuer ownership.
field_reconciliation.authority: AI-0/AI-1 approved trust/key registry, not caller-provided header
field_reconciliation.condition: Issuer-bound registry lookup with exact key ID namespace, algorithm, key generation, epoch and environment approval
field_reconciliation.version: KID and issuer_epoch/key rotation must be independently checked; no new key generated
field_reconciliation.signature_coverage: Key ID must be authenticated as part of proof context

field_reconciliation.source: Both W1 proposals use issued_at, but not necessarily equal business occurred_at. AI1 R005 uses numeric issued_at and original source event schema owns occurred_at separately.
field_reconciliation.authority: Trusted issuer clock and canonicalization, not HTTP client
field_reconciliation.condition: Only if approved time unit/clock-skew/expiry rule matches trusted source
field_reconciliation.version: Independent security envelope timestamp; never derive from event occurred_at or deletion outbox occurred_at
field_reconciliation.signature_coverage: Source proof timestamp may be covered after approved serialization

field_reconciliation.source: Both W1 candidate lists use nonce; AI1 R005 offline HMAC nonce is not a durable, independently fenced production replay receipt.
field_reconciliation.authority: Approved trusted issuer creates; independent receiver durable nonce fence pending
field_reconciliation.condition: Accepted only with issuer+key epoch+app/env+event binding and durable uniqueness/restore defense
field_reconciliation.version: Scope/version-specific replay protection; allow duplicate same event/digest only if persisted receipt is verified
field_reconciliation.signature_coverage: Nonce must be in canonical signed bytes if used

field_reconciliation.source: AI1 proposes irreversible session identifier hash, AI3 trusted_actor_ref is a trusted actor reference. These represent different entity domains, not aliases.
field_reconciliation.condition: Any optional link requires a server-side scoped binding audit; never public/convertible from user PII
field_reconciliation.version: Identifier binding revision must be tracked independently
field_reconciliation.signature_coverage: Proof must say which reference (if any) is covered by the signed bytes

field_reconciliation.source: AI1 hashed actor ref does not prove that AI3's trusted_member_ref targets the same member; account and actor may differ.
field_reconciliation.authority: AI-1 server principal→member mapping; identity must remain private
field_reconciliation.condition: Require server-only authenticated binding or no mapping; do not leak s_user_id/provider-sub/email
field_reconciliation.version: Separate member/account lifecycle and actor credential revision
field_reconciliation.signature_coverage: Approved binding must be explicit, never inferred from same string

field_reconciliation.source: AI1 R005 issuer_kid is signing-key identifier; AI3 W1 issuer_ref is origin/registry reference; key identity != origin identity.
field_reconciliation.authority: Issuer authority for issuer; key registry for kid
field_reconciliation.condition: Only a separately authenticated registry relation can link these values
field_reconciliation.version: Key rotation and issuer lineage independently versioned
field_reconciliation.signature_coverage: Both associations must be covered/verified under final scheme

field_reconciliation.source: R005 outer mac verifies HMAC on R005 synthetic envelope bytes; AI3 event_digest is digest for dedup/body identity; neither guarantees the other.
field_reconciliation.authority: Verified issuer algorithm/key authority vs AI3 digest/committed-source reviewer
field_reconciliation.condition: Never derive a signature proof from sha256 digest or use MAC string as a dedup digest without approved domain definition
field_reconciliation.signature_coverage: A digest may be a covered input but not itself verification

field_reconciliation.source: AI1 public core field schema_version and AI3 W1 envelope_version belong to separate layers in D06
field_reconciliation.authority: AI-0 core/schema authority and separately approved private envelope authority
field_reconciliation.condition: Explicit supported version-pair registry and independent migration review; no guessing G06 13th field
field_reconciliation.version: Independent version dimensions with reject-unknown; never map occurred_at to issued_at
field_reconciliation.signature_coverage: Signed object must bind BOTH versions before any actual trust

delivery_modes.name: SERVER_COMMITTED_REVOCATION_OR_DELETION
delivery_modes.trusted_source: AI-1 Auth unique writer verified source transaction, committed revoke/delete record, durable original outbox and server-level issuer provenance (all require future approval)
delivery_modes.post_transition_fence: Verify Auth-version/session-version monotonic transition and current revoked/deleted state + exact source event; stale current state/restore floor unknown block effects but preserve audit/recovery route for evidence review
delivery_modes.policy: Q104/Q119 legal hold and retention/erasure impact remain unapproved, therefore no real erasure/replay
delivery_modes.delivery: Server-origin transition may remain eligible for future reliable audit routing even though member is revoked/deleted. This is a DESIGN route, NOT live send/ACK now.

delivery_modes.name: USER_NOTIFICATION_DELIVERY
delivery_modes.trusted_source: approved signed source + scope; separate from Auth member revoke provenance
delivery_modes.post_transition_fence: Current member active, not revoked/deleted, session not expired, consent/preferences, recipient minimization, ordered message and legal policy must all pass at delivery
delivery_modes.policy: unknown/withdrawn consent or revoked member -> fail closed, quarantine/deny notification, not source revoke audit
delivery_modes.delivery: No user notification after account deletion or revoked/expired session without separately approved lawful exception and signed server-only basis.

critical_distinctions.auth_source_event: AI1 old account_deleted outbox is four fields; cannot infer Layer1 11 fields or private proof, but can be independently reread for existing R15 offline deleted-state review
critical_distinctions.owner_writer: AI1 Auth sole writer and committed source outbox; AI3 recipient local inbox+masked audit sole writer; no cross-D1 ACID
critical_distinctions.current_r004_fence: AI1 R004 source distinguishes notification active session vs revoked/deleted state; still OFFLINE review-only and must not be treated as signed production proof
critical_distinctions.private_layer: never expose private source issuer or session data in core resource_id/correlation_id/idempotency_key or public API
critical_distinctions.no_automatic_ack: AI3 W1 abstract ack_safe and old R14 receipt_only cannot authorize real Queue ACK

staging: No real D1/Queue/Secrets/OIDC/Store/EAS; no Preview/staging/production deploy/paid; no main; no H-Global/Echo
